title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-chris-patel
body:
3/04 quick triage notes - console observability

High-level: customer-reported dashboard showing blank charts and high error counts for 'model-inference-latency' route. Reported by ACME (account id 98765) during spike window 2026-03-03 14:22-14:38 UTC.

Immediate triage steps done:
- Pulled dashboard time range (14:15-14:45) and was able to reproduce blanks in 'per-route latency P50/P95' tiles.
- Checked backend metrics: spikes in 5xx in prod-cluster-3 (node group dedicated-1).
- Correlated with infra alerts: SRE alert SRE-1012 fired at 14:21 (high GPU memory pressure).
- Looked at request logs for trace ids (sample): trace=trc_abc123, trc_def456. Requests show 504s from proxy before reaching runtime.

Hypothesis:
- Proxy timeouts / routing fallback caused incomplete metrics aggregation, dashboard panels query backend endpoints which returned 502/504 -> panels render blank.
- Separate but related: one serving pod ran OOM-kill during the window, causing partial metric drops.

Next actions (owner assignments):
- [Chris] open Jira INF-2345 with reproduction steps, include logs and trace ids (todo: attach sample log snippets).
- [Aisha] escalate to infra on-call to validate GPU memory pressure root cause (linked SRE-1012).
- [Lee] check metrics ingestion pipeline (prometheus -> metrics-aggregator) for missed scrapes 14:15-14:40. Look at aggregator logs.
- [Samira] reach out to ACME CSM with interim note and ask for exact user flows and impact.

Repro steps for INF-2345 (notes):
1) Set dashboard range to 2026-03-03 14:15-14:45 UTC.
2) Run query for metric 'request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/api/v1/generate"}' in metrics-aggregator namespace.
3) Check upstream proxy (envoy-prod-cluster-3) logs for 502/504 entries around 14:20-14:25.
4) Check node metrics for dedicated-1 GPU memory (nvidia-smi snapshots stored in /var/log/gpu-metrics/).

Things to capture/attach to ticket:
- Grafana snapshots (share link) - TODO take snapshots and upload to Jira.
- Prometheus query outputs (CSV) for requested time range.
- Pod logs: runtime-0, proxy-2, metrics-aggregator-1.
- Core dump (if exists) from runtime-0 (ask infra).

Quick notes from slack thread (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02MONITOR/p1678201200000-0001):
- @infra on-call mentioned scheduled kernel update yesterday might have left drivers in inconsistent state, but no confirmed correlation.
- @sre noted a transient spike in scrape latency for metrics-aggregator at 14:19.

Temporary mitigations tried / considered:
- Increase proxy timeout from 15s -> 30s for route /api/v1/generate (risky; need canary).
- Add fallback to query cached metrics for dashboard if primary returns 5xx (frontend change; low effort but partial).

Prioritization: P1 for customer ACME (impacting dashboards and monitoring). Recommend escalation to on-call and keep customer updated every 60m until resolved.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Was there a correlated deploy around 14:00-14:20? Check GH PRs merged/rollout window. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/789 looks like merged 03-03 13:58 UTC, potentially related)
- Any scheduled infra maintenance? (check calendar: infra-maintenance 2026-03-03 12:00-16:00)
- Is metrics aggregation shard healthy for other clusters? (compare prod-cluster-1/2)

Follow-ups (timing):
- 15:00 UTC: internal sync with infra + SRE (30m). Owner: Chris to run and record action items.
- 16:30 UTC: update customer with current status and next steps. Owner: Samira.

Notes to self (short term TODOs):
- attach 3 screenshots to INF-2345 (grafana)
- copy sample 10 lines of proxy logs into ticket
- flag PR #789 in ticket as possible suspect
- check metrics-aggregator restart history (systemd/journal) for 03-03

Longer term ideas (record here):
- dashboard frontend: show partial data with warning when panels return 5xx (UX better than blank)
- add synthetic checks hitting metric endpoints every 5m to detect ingestion problems earlier
- add automated snapshot attach to JIRA when alert SRE-1012 fires (collect logs + metrics automatically)

Misc scratch (thinking out loud):
- Could use a lightweight buffering layer for metrics ingestion to avoid short time-window drops during pod restarts. Explore bucket queueing or remote_write temporary buffering.
- Consider setting up alert that fires when dashboard panels have >30% blank tiles in a dashboard (derived signal).

-- end of session notes --
summary: Triage scratchpad for ACME dashboard blanks; actions: open INF-2345, escalate SRE-1012, check PR #789 and metrics ingestion; follow-ups scheduled.
